study type: Secondary analysis of a randomized clinical trial (EAGeR trial)
cohort: 1,228 women (597 with a live birth) enrolled in the EAGeR trial
finding: Preconception-initiated daily low-dose aspirin was not associated with mode of delivery among women with one to two prior losses.
mod_finding: Preconception-initiated daily low-dose aspirin was not associated with risk of cesarean delivery.
